text:
carmen.customer: Hey support — our SIEM export for tenant acme-inc is missing a chunk of events from 2024-06-10 02:00-03:00 UTC. Only ~60% of auth events arrived, and Splunk shows only ~7d retention even though export.retention_days is set to 30. Can someone help?

alex.support: Sorry about that. Can you share the export id + any manifest or sample event ids? Also which sink (splunk/qradar) and region?

carmen.customer: export_id=exp_0a9f3b2c; sink=splunk-cloud; region=us-west-2. Sample missing event ids: evt_71a, evt_71b, evt_71c. Manifest prefix in S3: s3://acme-audit-exports/us-west-2/tenant=acme-inc/2024-06-10/02/

alex.support: Thanks. Quick check you can run: export status API to confirm manifest checksums and list missing objects.
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports/exp_0a9f3b2c/status"
```

maya.se: FYI we recently rolled out per-tenant sampling. If `audit.sample_rate` < 1.0 events can be dropped before export. Carmen, can you paste the tenant config (redact secrets)?

carmen.customer: tenant config (redacted): `audit.sample_rate: 0.6`, `export.retention_days: 30`, `sink: splunk`. We didn't knowingly change sample rate.

devon.sec: A couple of things to check quickly: 1) If forwarder fails to decrypt envelopes after a KMS alias rotation we sometimes see zero-byte manifests or omitted batches. 2) Manifests with gzip/content-length mismatch can cause the Splunk HEC to reject payloads. Look for `DecryptError` or `gzip: invalid header` in forwarder logs.

alex.support: Can you confirm whether any KMS alias rotations or HSM rewrap jobs ran around 2024-06-10 01:50-02:10 UTC? Check CloudTrail/KMS logs.

export-bot: scheduled-replay: Replay job exp_0a9f3b2c queued (ticket #SUP-1129).

taylor.eng: I'll jump in to reproduce. Plan: 1) call export status API; 2) `aws s3 ls` the S3 prefix for zero-byte objects; 3) tail forwarder logs in us-west-2 for `DecryptError` / `gzip` errors; 4) compare `exports.ingested_count` vs `splunk.sent_count`.

alex.support: For immediate mitigation, if you need full fidelity set `audit.sample_rate: 1.0` so events aren't sampled while we investigate. We'll also trigger a replay of the missing manifests to your Splunk sink.

carmen.customer: Doing that now — updated `audit.sample_rate` to 1.0 via Console and saved.

devon.sec: After replay completes, verify counts and retention: check the exported manifests' `start_ts`/`end_ts` and the Splunk index `_internal` logs for HEC rejects. If counts still mismatch, escalate to eng-runtime for forwarder debug.

taylor.eng: Assigned to eng-runtime and paging @eng-runtime. I'm fetching logs now; will paste relevant snippets and S3 object listing shortly.

alex.support: Thanks all. Next steps: eng-runtime to validate forwarder/KMS behavior and apply hotfix if needed; support to monitor replay status and confirm with customer; customer to validate SIEM retention and received event counts. :thumbsup:
